mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS candidate_id, c.display_name, c.status, c.created_at, p.title AS position_title FROM candidate c JOIN position p ON p.id = c.position_id WHERE c.position_id = #{positionId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO candidate (position_id, display_name, region, career_level, masked_text, status) VALUES (#{positionId}, #{displayName}, #{region}, #{careerLevel}, #{maskedText}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE candidate SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = #{id}
